inspectIntro: Reading device information only. No unlock, wipe, or flash.
adbSelectionError: Connect exactly one authorized ADB device, or select one with -Serial.
noFlash: This result is NOT flash authorization. Boot and rollback remain unverified.
profileMismatch: Stock profile mismatch or missing data. Do not flash.
profileMatched: Public stock profile matched. Candidate for Android 10 GSI testing only.
downloadIntro: Fetching the existing PHH Android 10 GSI base. Not a finished CTZ ROM.
gappsWarning: GApps is a separate upstream distribution. Play Store operation, certification and redistribution rights are not guaranteed.
planOnly: Plan only. Nothing downloaded or flashed.
existingDownload: Checking an existing file without overwriting it.
hashWarning: No trusted upstream SHA256 is pinned. Computed SHA256 is a receipt, not authenticity verification.
extractHint: Extract the XZ file separately with 7-Zip or similar, then inspect the image.
